entities.name: Control plane only indication
entities.description: An information element included by the network to indicate that the associated PDN connection is only for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: PDN connection for control plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: A condition where the PDN connection is established solely for control plane CIoT EPS optimization purposes.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity responsible for including the Control plane only indication IE under specific conditions.

relations.description: The network includes the Control plane only indication IE when the PDN connection is for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.
The presence of the Control plane only indication IE is conditional on the PDN connection being for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.
